title: Jist Template
description: Defines a Jist template tree — a versioned JSON structure of layout containers and leaf components that a Jist renderer converts into native UI. Each component binds to data via its `name` property and can be styled via theme variants.

version.description: Spec version this template targets (e.g. "1", "2"). The renderer silently skips templates with unsupported versions.

root.description: Root of the template tree. Must be a container node (layout, action, or dynamicLayout).

rootNode.description: A container node that can serve as the template root. Only container types (layout, action, dynamicLayout) are allowed at the root level.

spacingObject.description: Spacing values for margin. All values are unitless numbers (px on web, pt on iOS, dp on Android).

componentNode.description: Any component node in the template tree. Discriminated by the `type` field. Each variant carries a stable `x-jist-tag` ID (wire-stable across renames).

layoutNode.description: Flex container that arranges children along a single axis. Can be nested to any depth. Layout is structural — it is not themed.

margin.description: Outer spacing around this layout container.

children.description: Ordered child nodes rendered inside this container.

actionNode.description: Clickable wrapper that makes its children interactive. Fires an onAction event when activated (click/tap, Enter/Space key). Renders even if bound data is absent.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` provides the action payload (any shape). Also generates a CSS class `jist__<name>` when name differs from 'action'.

meta.description: Static metadata included in the onAction callback. Use for tracking events, routing hints, or other template-level data that doesn't come from the message.

children.description: Child nodes rendered inside the clickable wrapper.

headingNode.description: Text heading with semantic level. The variant determines both the semantic level (h2/h3/h4) and the style. Renders empty if bound data is absent.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` provides the heading text. Defaults to 'heading' when omitted.

variant.description: Semantic level and style variant. Determines the HTML tag on web and the font style from the theme.

textNode.description: General-purpose text content. Renders empty if bound data is absent.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` provides the text content. Defaults to 'text' when omitted.

variant.description: Style variant name. Maps to a named sub-object in the theme's text config.

dateNode.description: Formatted timestamp. The display text is produced by the formatDate callback. Renders empty if bound data is absent.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` provides an ISO 8601 date string. Defaults to 'date' when omitted.

variant.description: Style variant name. Maps to a named sub-object in the theme's date config.

buttonNode.description: Action button that fires an onAction event when clicked. NOT rendered if the bound data field is absent — templates can include optional buttons without conditional logic.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` must provide `{ label: string, url: string }`. The label becomes the button text.

variant.description: Style variant (e.g., 'primary', 'secondary'). Maps to a named sub-object in the theme's button config.

meta.description: Static metadata included in the onAction callback. Use for tracking events, routing hints, or other template-level data.

imageNode.description: Image loaded from a URL. NOT rendered if the bound data field is absent. Sizing and scaling are template-level properties because they control how this specific template uses the image.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` provides the image source URL (string).

variant.description: Style variant name. Maps to a named sub-object in the theme's image config.

oneOf.description: Expand to fill the container width.

width.description: Image width. Use a number for fixed size or 'fill' to expand to container.

objectFit.description: How the image fills its box. 'contain' = fit within bounds, 'cover' = fill bounds (clips), 'fill' = stretch to fill.

borderRadius.description: Corner rounding (unitless — px/pt/dp). Use width/2 for a circle.

dynamicLayoutNode.description: A layout that repeats a single template node for each item in a data array. Combines the layout properties of a regular layout with data-driven iteration.

name.description: Data binding key. `data[name]` must be an array of objects. Each object becomes the data context for one rendering of the template.

direction.description: Main axis direction for arranging repeated items. Defaults to 'vertical'.

margin.description: Outer spacing around the dynamic layout container.

template.description: A single node rendered once per item. Data binding within this node resolves against the current array item, not the top-level data. Use a layout node as the template to render multiple elements per item.

templateNode.description: References a named template from the template registry. The referenced template's root node is rendered in place, using the current data context. Useful for reusing template fragments, especially within dynamicLayout.

name.description: Name of the template to reference. Must match a key in the templates registry passed to the renderer.
